subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Should Feishu conversation routing use this PR's `feishu:<peerId>` default plus `feishu:account:<id>` escape, or should OpenClaw preserve `feishu:<account>` and add a different explicit peer/plugin-owned grammar?
rationale: The central fix is valid, but the permanent public bind grammar changes documented account-selection behavior and overlaps with other open candidate PRs, so automation should not choose it implicitly.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add a peer path
options.body: Keep documented `feishu:<account>` semantics and add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and tests.

options.title: Accept this PR's grammar
options.body: Adopt `feishu:<peerId>` as the default and require the PR to add upgrade notes, docs, account escape coverage, and real proof.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Pause this PR and select another open candidate after comparing grammar, compatibility, proof, and mergeability.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add a peer path
recommendation.body: Keep documented `feishu:<account>` semantics and add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the adjacent account-scoped bind command surface, so they are the clearest history owner for the account-vs-peer CLI contract.
